Under the hood

Everything on chain is read and planned with @ammora-protocol/sdk 0.3.9. Nothing is custodial: the app only prepares transactions and your wallet signs them.

import { AmmoraV4LaunchCurveClient, classifyAmmoraV4ExactInputFill,
  giwaSepoliaAutoRoute } from "@ammora-protocol/sdk";

const curve  = new AmmoraV4LaunchCurveClient(client, curveAddr, core);
const state  = await curve.getState();                 // price, reserves, fee
const prog   = await curve.getMigrationProgressAtBlock(state.asOfBlock);
const quote  = await curve.quoteExactInput(amountIn, false);
const plan   = await curve.planSwapExactInput({ includedAmountIn: amountIn,
  baseForQuote: false, allowPartialFill: fill.allowPartialFill,
  slippageBps: 100, recipient, deadline });            // approvals + tx
